title: My Mother`s Death
author: Himanshu Parida / ହିମାଂଶୁ ପରିଡା
text:
From tomorrow the daily newspaper

My mother used to read regularly

Shall be stopped.

The diapers and bedspreads purchased online

in bulk, shall be returned.

The list of medicenes requisitioned from the chemist

Shall not be sent this month.

The dedicated chair for my mother at the dinning table

Shall fall vacant henceforth.

The wheel chair made ready

for my mother`s limited movement

is folded, stacked on the chaja

as it will never take off.

The physiotherapist shall stop visiting our house

The cheques meant for withdrawal

From my mother`s pension account shall be stale.

The current news on the death my mother

will come out fresh.

The morning sun peeping through the window

Of the room where my mother had lain

Shall stop as the window is not opened.

From morning till we go to bed

Manything would be as usual

But in the morning tea and

In the preparation of lunch

Deliberately some portion

shall remain as leftovers.

Some of my friends shall ask regarding her

And they will express their wonder;

How she without any ailment of old age

Suddenly had passed away

Did she not have the desire to live any more ?
Gradually the time will pass away

And the time we had kept for our mother

Shall no more engage us.

Noboby need to attend her interest to tell

All the stories she has stored for us

By reluctantly listening to them.

We would only hear some sounds

as resounds of her voice in a vacant place

which would be soon forgotten.

Now all other things going on in a routine way

Shall go on without our mother.
